exact_source_headers: OBJ, mhclo and mhmat explicitly release the asset as CC0 in September 2020; all original headers retained.
adaptation: Original Fury importer applies mhclo fitting anchors to the existing PlayerBody morphed full source. Select 10 connected scalp components with minimum normalized Y above 0.37; exclude the long ponytail. An original compact folded bun is authored at the source gather point. Near source faces are triangulated; Blender 4.3.2 collapse ratio 0.30 generates genuine Far geometry. UV triangles are clipped at U 0.5 into two 192-pixel atlas cells. Optional per-Player 512/1024 RGBA detail maps only those scalp cells. Source hue is removed while authored strand and cluster reflectance variation is retained; this may include authored broad shading and is not a scattering model. Alpha is retained. No source likeness or face change.
excluded_research: Rehman Polanski brown-bun is not included because index CC0 conflicts with embedded AGPL3; no source bytes are used.

normal_repairs.method: split only corners of the small gather faces whose averaged smooth normal opposed the actual face; retain geometry and triangle winding, then rerun unchanged winding predicate

short_tail_adaptation.option: FURY_PLAYER_SHORT_TAIL=1 requires FURY_PLAYER_SOURCE_HAIR=1; both default off
short_tail_adaptation.description: Optional shortened CC0 source ponytail components replace the original source-groom fallback fold. Near keeps source topology plus atlas-cut corners; Far uses a separately warped, reduced silhouette. This is not a physically simulated hair system.
short_tail_adaptation.normal_policy: Head/Neck blend by normalized source height; scoped unit-face CSR normal reconstruction and posed original-parent edge projection preserve UV cuts.
limitations: Far is intentionally shorter/simpler, with visible silhouette and LOD-transition limitations.
DXR uses the base atlas; high-resolution per-instance color detail remains untested on DXR.
Main integration requires new whole-scene, pose and exact render acceptance.
